part1.title: Part 1 - Look and read
part1.instruction: Choose the correct words and write them on the lines. There is one example.

example.text: This person helps children learn mathematics, English and science at school.

questions.text: This person works outdoors on a farm taking care of cows, sheep and crops.
You go to this big building to buy food, fruits and things for your house.
This warm piece of clothing is worn over your clothes when it is cold outdoors.
This wild animal from Australia can jump high on two legs and carry its baby in a pouch.
You go to this dark place to sit in comfortable seats and watch movies on a big screen.

part3.title: Part 3 - Complete the Story
part3.instruction: Read the story. Choose a word from the box. Write the correct word next to numbers 1-5. There is one example.
part3.storyText: Yesterday morning, Charlie wanted to make surprise pancakes for his mum's birthday. He went into the [example: kitchen] very quietly while Mum was sleeping. He found milk, eggs and a bag of white (1) ________ in the cupboard. But when he mixed them in a bowl, he accidentally dropped the spoon and made a big (2) ________ on the floor! Charlie was worried, so he quickly started (3) ________ the table and floor with a towel. Just then, Mum walked in and looked (4) ________! 'Happy Birthday, Mum!' Charlie said. They laughed together and made the most (5) ________ pancakes!

titleQuestion.question: Now choose the best name for the story. Tick one box.

part4.title: Part 4 - Factual Text
part4.instruction: Read the text. Choose the right words and write them on the lines.
paragraphs: Elephants are the largest land animals in the world. They live in places (1) ________ Africa and Asia.
An elephant has a very long nose called a trunk. Elephants use (2) ________ trunks to pick up food, drink water and even wash themselves!
They eat plants, leaves and fruit, but they (3) ________ eat meat. They spend many hours every day looking for food.
Elephants love playing in mud and water because it helps keep their skin cool (4) ________ hot days.
Baby elephants are called calves, and they stay near (5) ________ mothers for many years to learn how to live in the wild.

part5.title: Part 5 - Complete Sentences about the Story
part5.instruction: Look at the pictures and read the story. Write 1, 2 or 3 words to complete the sentences.

storyPassages.text: Last Tuesday, Ben and his class took a big blue bus to the city zoo with their teacher Miss Green. Ben was very excited because he wanted to see the tall giraffes.
First, they visited the monkey house. A funny little brown monkey jumped down and tried to take Ben's yellow banana from his bag! Everyone laughed loudly.
Next, Miss Green took a group photograph of the children in front of the lion enclosure. At the end of the afternoon, Ben bought a small toy giraffe at the zoo shop to take home.

part6.title: Part 6 - Look and read and write
part6.instruction: Look at the picture and read the prompts. Write your answers on the lines.
part6.promptText: Look carefully at the bathroom scene with the bears and answer all 6 questions.
